leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic Node.js server with Express to serve as a BFF
Configure multiple HTTP client requests to external services within a single endpoint
Integrate data from disparate API responses into a unified JSON structure
Manipulate incoming service data to transform fields for client consumption
Implement error handling for failed service requests in the aggregation flow
Initialize and manage asynchronous operations using async/await for concurrent service calls
Apply middleware to parse incoming requests and format outgoing BFF responses
lessonTitle: Build BFF endpoint aggregating multiple services
